instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Once upon a time, there was a king and queen who had spent years wishing for a child. When the queen gave birth to their daughter, they were overjoyed.
They threw a huge party but, because they only had 12 gold plates, they only invited 12 of the land’s 13 fairies.
While the 12 fairies blessed the newborn child with their wishes, the 13th wicked fairy showed up and placed a curse on the princess.

atoms.a: What did the wicked fairy do?

instruction.text: Drag the words to the correct definitions.

atoms.b: a wish for harm or misfortune

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
According to the wicked fairy’s curse, the princess would die on her fifteenth birthday after pricking her finger on a spinning wheel.
In an attempt to save her, one of the other fairies tried to reverse the curse, so that rather than dying, the princess would slip into a hundred-year slumber.
And so it was: the princess pricked herself, and everyone in the castle, including her, fell into a deep sleep.

atoms.a: When did the princess prick her finger?
Who slipped into a deep sleep?
b: ++the princess and everyone in the castle

atoms.a: Why do you think the fairies wanted to save the princess?
b: ++because they grant wishes and do good for others
because the king and queen told them to

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
As they slept and slept, a high wall of thorns grew around the castle.
Many sons of kings tried to climb the bushes to reach the sleeping princess, but none succeeded.
Until one day, a prince reached the castle and the thorns had turned to flowers. He finally found Sleeping Beauty.
As he gave the princess a gentle kiss, she and everyone else awoke from their sleep.

atoms.a: How did the princess wake up?
b: The princes came to visit the castle.
She was woken by the King.
++She was woken by the prince’s kiss.

atoms.a: What was the sign that the curse was going to be broken?
b: Sons of kings trying to climb the castle.
